item.title: Putin is trying to pitch himself as peacemaker in Iran, but Russia also sees opportunity
item.summary: The Kremlin wants to exert its influence in the Middle East and has publicly said its support for Iran, a strategic ally, is unwavering. But experts say there are limits to how far Moscow will go: It does not want to antagonize Washington, and it also stands to gain economical...

item.title: Israel strikes on Lebanon expand, as Iran's new supreme leader issues 1st statement
Russia sentences 19 people for deadly concert hall attack that killed 149 people
item.summary: A court in Moscow on Thursday convicted 19 people of involvement in the 2024 shooting rampage at a Moscow concert hall that killed 149 people and wounded over 600 in one of the deadliest attacks in the capital in years.

item.title: U.S. must admit responsibility for deadly airstrike on Iranian school if at fault, says Republican
item.summary: A Republican senator says the U.S. must not pretend Iran school strike didn't happen, and admit to the mistake if in fact the U.S. military was responsible for the attack.

item.title: Air Transat, Air Canada adjusting ticket prices as jet fuel costs weigh on airlines
item.summary: Air Transat is charging more for flights to Europe and Air Canada is adjusting prices as the soaring cost of jet fuel — triggered by an oil crisis that has emerged from the war in the Middle East — weighs on Canadian and international carriers.

item.title: Russia accuses Britain of helping Ukraine in missile strike that killed 6
item.summary: The Kremlin on Wednesday accused British specialists of involvement in a deadly Ukrainian strike on the Russian city of ‌Bryansk that used British Storm Shadow missiles and said it would take Britain's role "into account."

item.title: Why would a desalination plant be a military target? | About That
item.summary: Andrew Chang explains how the war in the Middle East is threatening critical freshwater infrastructure in the region. Images provided by The Canadian Press, Reuters and Getty Images

item.title: How Trump's timeline for the war on Iran keeps shifting, and why that matters
item.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump and his secretary of war have given multiple and often contradictory descriptions of how long they expect the military operation against Iran to continue.

item.title: Canada raises alarm about escalating violence in Lebanon
item.summary: The Canadian government said Tuesday it is alarmed by the escalation of violence and attacks in Lebanon, as the war in the Middle East expands. It called on all sides to uphold humanitarian law.
